claims: Antoine Pettway is the head coach of the Kennesaw State University men's basketball team.
Antoine Pettway was hired on April 8, 2023.
Antoine Pettway is the eighth head coach in Kennesaw State University men's basketball program history.
Antoine Pettway led the Kennesaw State University men's basketball team to the 2026 NCAA Tournament.
Antoine Pettway spent 15 years as a coach at Alabama.
Antoine Pettway was an assistant coach/director of operations at Alabama from 2008 to 2023.
Antoine Pettway progressed from walk-on to starter at Alabama during his playing career.
Antoine Pettway led the Owls to their second-ever Division I NCAA Tournament appearance in 2026.
Antoine Pettway took over the Kennesaw State University men's basketball program after the departure of former head coach Amir Abdur-Rahim.
Amir Abdur-Rahim left for USF in 2023.
Antoine Pettway has maintained the "love wins" culture established by his predecessor.
